answer: Each submission hangs on the lantern of a task receipt, and the quill is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the plume of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
